rows.title: CLOSED-LOOP-1: no artifact without a consuming loop, no wait on a person
rows.body: Rowan 2026-11-12: assume nothing is read, reviewed or decided by a person. Policy values in doctrine/closed-loop.json and closed_loop in autonomy/policy.json; foundation/orphans.py fails CI on a new orphan artifact, a non-identity-bound wait or a failing ledger probe; lessons and decisions are ledger rows with probes, not pages.

rows.title: Write-back is an executable ledger row, not a page
rows.body: writeback record --kind lesson|decision writes doctrine/decision-ledger.json with a required file or grep probe; closedloop --check runs every probe.

rows.title: Orphan scan delegates to the document audit
rows.body: CLOSED-LOOP-1 (orphans.py) and DOC-CONSUMED-1 (docs_audit.py) measured the same thing two ways. The document audit is the single definition; orphans.py keeps the human-wait check, the decision ledger and the backlog issue, and reads orphan documents from docs_audit.

rows.title: Fleet skips archived repositories
rows.body: ultrastable/seed is archived and read-only; its live copy is the seed directory of this repository. The fleet lane lists live repositories only and records an archived one instead of failing or opening a card.

rows.title: Deploy was green while live served old code
rows.body: Merged site 0.3.1 never went live: worker.js imports ../seed/analytics/analytics.js, the single-file upload returned code 10021, deploy-site.mjs ignored success=false, and the verify step fetched only an image. Measured after the fix: curl https://ultrastable.io/health returned version 0.3.1 and /org returned 200 (before: 0.2.0 and 404). deploy-site now runs on push to main for site paths; deploy exits nonzero unless the live version equals the repo VERSION; lane no longer fails on the concurrent-merge race.

rows.title: Bootstrap settings script reported success while doing nothing
rows.body: apply_github_settings.sh printed failures: 0 with jq missing, so every step was a no-op; it also failed on CRLF jq output, targeted six archived repos, omitted workers/spec/license, and treated GitHub plan limits as permanent red. Measured after the fix: running it from an org-admin gh session returned 'failures: 0 gated: 8' and the org description matches the config. It now requires jq and gh, strips CR, skips archived repos and reports plan-gated features as GATED. Lane merges via GITHUB_TOKEN never fire push workflows, so the lane dispatches deploy-site after merging deployable paths, and scripts/drift_probe.sh compares live version and org description daily; measured: site live=0.3.1 repo=0.3.1.

rows.title: Code repo holds code; administration lives in ops; the front door is one prompt bar
rows.body: Measured: 27 of 44 open issues in ultrastable/ultrastable were administration (funding, patent, legal, owner cards, org setup) and were transferred to the private ultrastable/ops repo; 19 code tasks remain and are executor-owned. Site 0.4.0 adds /start, a single prompt bar that stores a plain-words idea in KV; node site/site.test.mjs passes with the page and the POST. Next, tracked in ops: executor reads its queue from repo data so Issues can be disabled on the code repo, the idea consumer asks follow-up questions and scaffolds a Cloudflare Worker, and the six archived duplicate repos are removed after a mirror backup.

rows.title: Six archived duplicate repos deleted after mirror backup
rows.body: Measured: gh repo list ultrastable now shows ultrastable, ops, license, spec, workers and .github only. Before deletion each of seed, platform, docs, site, business and ip was mirror-cloned (1 ref each, 87K to 515K) to repo-backups outside the repository; their content already lives in ultrastable/ultrastable.

rows.title: BUILD-1: the product is idea to live site in one prompt bar, no setup
rows.body: Measured: on ultrastable.io (site 0.5.0) a plain-words idea posted to /api/idea became a hosted page at /s/<id> in about 20 seconds using Workers AI and KV, with no account, key, repo or terminal; the change form regenerates it. node site/site.test.mjs covers idea, build, serve and change. Generated pages run under a sandbox CSP. Limits found: no shared back end yet (data stays in the visitor's browser), pages live on a path of ultrastable.io rather than their own address. Next: per-site database and wildcard subdomain, tracked in ultrastable/ops.

rows.title: USER-PATH-1: guided set-up is data, one yes/no question per screen, plain words only
rows.body: Measured: https://ultrastable.io/setup (site 0.6.0) walked in a real browser: yes to GitHub, typed a name, step 3 opened https://github.com/ultrastable/ultrastable/generate and showed the confirm screen; progress persisted in localStorage. The steps live in doctrine/user-path.json, site/userpath.js is generated, and scripts/gen_userpath.py --check (a step in checks) fails on technical words, non-https links or stale output. ultrastable/ultrastable is now a GitHub template so the Make my copy click works for anyone with access. Next in ultrastable/ops: first-run workflow in the copy that enables its own autopilot without a click, Cloudflare Deploy button once the seed is public, OAuth connections for Google and Buffer.

rows.title: The front door asks what it does not know and audits what it built
rows.body: Verified live on ultrastable.io (site 0.7.0): an idea produced 3 tap-only questions, the answers entered the build brief, the page was live in about 30 s, and an independent model (llama-3.3-70b, not the qwen builder) published /s/<id>/review listing 4 done, 5 gaps and the standing limits. Problems found by that run: a deprecated hard-coded model id had silently disabled the audit, so every AI call now walks a model list (re-probed, audit returns real findings); builds and audits run in separate requests because waitUntil is capped near 30 s; a stuck build now fails after 150 s. node site/site.test.mjs passes the whole flow. Pattern from QNFO prompted recall.

rows.title: Backgrounded AI build was evicted and left sites stuck at building
rows.body: Measured: a live POST to /api/idea returned a make URL that still showed Building after more than 2 minutes, while a direct Workers AI call for the same kind of page took 28 s. The build ran in waitUntil, which is cut off about 30 s after the response, so the state never left building. Fixed in site 0.5.1: the job is stored, the /make request awaits the build, a 120 s claim stops duplicate builds, an evicted build is resumed by the next poll, and tries are capped at 3 before the state becomes failed. node site/site.test.mjs covers the build, the change and the capped failure.

rows.title: COMPLETE-1: finished work and finished threads are closed automatically
rows.body: Standing owner rule written into agents/AGENTS.md, seed/agents/AGENTS.md and agents/PROJECT-INSTRUCTIONS.md. Verified by running scripts/completion_sweep.sh against the live repo: it deleted 2 squash-merged branches (agent/brand-settings-buildout, claude/project-thread-pi8gkc) and left every branch with unmerged commits or an open PR alone; gaplint reports 0 findings. The sweep runs in the daily lane workflow. Session side: the app already archives on PR close and after 1 idle day (probed with get_settings), and 5 idle finished sessions were archived. Next: sweep closes done issues with evidence and ops-repo threads.

rows.title: Work queue is repository data; Issues are turned off on the code repo

The executor now picks from foundation/queue.py (EXECUTOR_SOURCE=issues restores the old source), claims nothing remotely, and closes the item inside its own pull request so the merge is the closure; three consecutive failures park an item. Issue scripts exit 0 when has_issues is false, funding findings become queue items, and tests/foundation/test_executor.py covers the queue.

rows.body: The first live executor run opened PR 233 for Q-10 as a draft with zero checks, because a PR opened with GITHUB_TOKEN raises no pull_request event and a draft runs no CI, so the lane had nothing to merge. Measured after the fix: python3 -m pytest tests/foundation/test_executor.py returned 9 passed and the executor now marks the PR ready and dispatches checks.yml on its branch right after pr create, recording any failed kick in the log row.

rows.title: Executor PRs failed the write-back gate

rows.title: POSITION: say what Ultrastable is not for
rows.body: The home page lists what Ultrastable is not for (one-off pages, prompt-by-prompt vibe coding) and agent.md tells assistants to stop when the idea is a one-off page, so people self-select into ongoing systems that need setup and a paid back end.

rows.title: Site claims must link to issues and code (SITE-PINS-1)
rows.body: A public-site status pin or honest gap with no docs/issues item and no existing code path is a defect. site/pins.json plus scripts/build_site_roadmap.py --check enforce it; doctrine/market.json engineer-lane now proves site/pins.json.

rows.title: Parallel sessions built the same site-pins system; merge into one source of truth
rows.body: PINS-1 (computed pins) collided with SITE-PINS-1 (#247) on main. Kept SITE-PINS-1 (site/pins.json, scripts/build_site_roadmap.py) as the single source for the site and kept only the shrink-only ratchet for roadmap issues without a runnable probe (foundation/pins.py, doctrine/pins-baseline.json). Lesson: before building a surface, read origin/main and open PRs for the same directive.

rows.title: Generated demos must be linted; a static page cannot be an autonomous system
rows.body: Design-system prompt plus model-free lint feeding repair plus honest limits wording. Open: screenshot-critique pass.

rows.title: Pilot model: bring-your-own-account first; hosted deferred; dashboard shows Ultrastable on itself
rows.body: Owner worried that hosting customers on our Cloudflare creates data-protection, encryption and isolation burden and that a thin demo does not show the back end. Decision: pilots run in the customer's own account (no customer data on our infrastructure); revenue hypotheses (paid pilot then subscription for playbooks, dashboard and support) are data in doctrine/pilot-model.json with probes; /dashboard shows the real control plane computed from the repo with the live feed explicitly pending (Q-LOOP-live-clock). Revert: offer hosted only after the isolation and processor terms are built.

rows.title: Pilot is an application program; layers are recursive; multi-tenant is a separate gated obligation
rows.body: Owner: sell the pilot as open applications for strong use cases and interesting demos of autonomous code loops and virtual agent managers; price set by what the market bears; multi-tenant is possible but a different data-protection obligation; the system is recursive (platform on its own infrastructure, customer systems on it, systems on those). Encoded: doctrine/pilot-model.json program, layers, multi_tenant_obligations; bootstrap records parent and level and adds M-parent-link; /pilot renders the program from data. Intake handler, first child link and multi-tenant controls are filed as Q-PILOT-application-intake, Q-LAYER-child-reporting, Q-GAP-multi-tenant-controls.

rows.title: Tenant 0 model and application-as-interview
rows.body: Advisory from owner: treat the platform as tenant 0 of its own model; same shape at every level; isolation from the start so multi-tenant is stricter isolation not a rewrite; application form is the system-test interview. Built: POST /api/pilot scores the four system-test answers; metrics/objectives carry tenant_id and a runtime measures only its own tenant (tested); dashboard takes a tenant id and 404s unknown tenants. Remaining: tenant_id on core tables and per-tenant credentials (Q-TENANT-row-isolation), child reporting (Q-LAYER-child-reporting). Price: left open, a real monthly quote is the owner's market call per hypotheses H1/H2.

rows.title: Server-side only: GitHub Actions on its built-in token is the credential-free route
rows.body: Owner directive 2026-11-12: Ultrastable runs server-side only. The scheduler host on a person's computer, its two launch scripts, the browser sign-in script and the desktop task definition were removed. The No-single-route rule stays; its credential-free route is now the GitHub Actions loop host, because GitHub mints the workflow token for each run and no person mints it (deploy/routes.json person_free_credentials). The failover chain is Cloudflare worker 0 h, cloud-hosted Claude routine 3 h, GitHub Actions 12 h behind a daily gate. Measured: python3 scripts/check_routes.py prints 'routes ok: credential-free route is server-side (github-actions)'; python3 -m foundation serverside --check prints 'serverside ok'.

rows.title: The lane workflow is the server-side needs-pat merger
rows.body: PRs that change .github/workflows are merged by scripts/lane.sh in lane.yml, on green and on the exact head commit, with a workflow-capable credential resolved by scripts/lane_credential.py: LANE_PAT, then a GitHub App installation token (LANE_APP_ID, LANE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY). PRs labeled hold are skipped. Measured on 2026-11-12: PR 222 changed lane.yml and its lane review was posted by github-actions[bot], so the lane ran on the built-in token and LANE_PAT was not bound then; with no credential the lane leaves such PRs open, green and labeled needs-pat and logs waiting=N. The owner step is the single item lane-credential in foundation/data/needs-you.json with that default in effect. Evidence: tests/foundation/test_lane_merger.py, 10 tests pass.

rows.title: Test helpers left a repository copy per test in the temp directory
rows.body: copy_repo() and tiny_repo() called tempfile.mkdtemp() and nothing removed the result. Measured on main before the fix: one run of python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/foundation left 113 directories and 781 MB in the temp directory; on the larger checkout three runs filled a 117 GB disk. Fix: tests/foundation/_repo.py scratch() registers removal with the running test (addCleanup, addClassCleanup), at interpreter exit, and sweeps directories a killed run left; every bare mkdtemp in tests/foundation goes through it and test_repo_cleanup.py fails a new bare one. Measured after the fix: the same run leaves 0 directories.

rows.title: Closing probes proved code existed, not that loops ran
rows.body: Every closing probe in the loop registry was file: or grep:, so loops verify passed while two workflows had never run. Measured 2026-11-12 12:58 UTC through the GitHub API: loop.yml 0 runs, fleet.yml 0 runs; executor log row 0.8 h old and session ledger row 0.5 h old on their evidence branches. Fix: foundation/liveness.py reads run evidence per probe in instances/ultrastable/liveness.json and gives alive, stale, failing, never or unknown; every launch pass runs it and files a queue item per loop that is not alive. Both workflows were dispatched on main at 12:59 UTC to start them.

rows.title: Tick loader resolved paths with URL.pathname
rows.body: platform/selfhost/tick.mjs and the GCP adapter built file paths from URL.pathname, which is percent-encoded and on Windows begins with a slash before the drive letter, so the migrations directory was looked up at a doubled drive path there and at dir%20with%20space on any host whose checkout path has a space. Measured before the fix on Linux: selfhost boot from a copy under 'dir with space' returned status failed, ENOENT scandir .../dir%20with%20space/seed/worker/migrations. Fix: fileURLToPath. Measured after: tests/foundation/test_selfhost.py test_full_tick_from_a_path_that_needs_url_decoding passes; the GCP adapter tests pass. The http metric source in seed/worker/src/tick.js had no test; seed/worker/test/measure.test.js now covers 2xx, error status, unreachable host and recovery.

rows.title: Fit is the system test, not B2B and not revenue
rows.body: Owner, 2026-11-12: the use cases are not only B2B. A personal system (a companion, a signals desk for markets or news) qualifies when it needs ongoing agentic upkeep and its owner accepts a running cost; storefronts are left to shop builders and the product is not pitched on revenue. docs/doctrine/VISION.md and its seed copy now say the owner can be an organization, a small business or one person, drop the shop example and list selling online under what it is not for; site/suggest.js replaces the shop suggestion with two personal systems. Measured: tests/test_vision.py 5 tests pass, including a one-person signals desk that passes the bootstrap qualify stage.

rows.title: TRANSPARENCY-1: everything about how Ultrastable runs is read-only public
rows.body: Owner 2026-11-12: full transparency, everybody read-only; changes keep the e-mailed code. /live and /api/live serve a snapshot from foundation/transparency.py published to D1 each launch pass. Open: most registry loops have no recorded run; /owner is shadowed by the site worker.

rows.body: Any queue or doc change makes site/dashboard-data.js stale, so the executor's own pre-PR checks failed. The executor now runs scripts/build_dashboard.py before its checks and before the commit.

rows.title: executor abandoned a change on the first failed check
rows.body: The model's Q-10 change violated the server-side-only rule (localhost) and the executor discarded it. It now tells the model the rule and feeds failed check output back for up to 2 repairs before abandoning.

rows.body: A JSONDecodeError from the model reply ended the run with no repair. Unusable replies now count as a failed attempt and the model is asked again, within the same REPAIRS budget.

rows.title: CLOCKWORK-1 and GROWTH-1: loops are measured clocks; the product manager owns growth
rows.body: Measured 2026-11-12: the tick heartbeat ran 318 times in 2.2 days with 0 s median jitter; the executor's only recurring clock was one cron per day because no dispatch token is bound to the tick worker. foundation/clock.py measures every clock (ticking, late, stopped, idle) from recorded beats; the executor wakes its own next run when takeable work remains (4 per day cap, back off after 3 failures, budget guard applies); tests pass. foundation/growth.py measures the growth share of merges (target 40 percent) and the growth metrics (baseline 1310 page views, 564 visitors, 817 agent hits, 326 pilot page views in 7 days), and the executor takes a growth item first when the mix is below target; tests pass. Six growth items filed. Fixed, with a test that passes: a model returning an object instead of a string crashed the executor.

rows.title: clock report truncated the tick beats to ten hours
rows.body: The d1 clock read only the last 60 beats, so beats in 24 hours showed 60 of 144 for a heartbeat that ticks every 10 minutes. The window now covers a full day plus a margin; a test pins it; ran against the account and the count matches the expectation.

rows.title: LANE-WATCH-1: green PRs may not stay open
rows.body: Session: session_0156nqDrGFZaa8zQwcdGZNQU. Measured: PR 264 changed workflow files, so the built-in token could not merge it and the lane left it open with no credential bound; PRs 238 and 249 were red on stale branches and 268 conflicted after main moved. The lane now runs foundation lanewatch after each merge pass and fails when a green mergeable PR is older than 30 minutes, naming the cause; the crosswalk bans reporting a PR as waiting for review.

rows.title: CLOCKWORK-2 and GROWTH-2: stages, catch-up, settlement, escalation; targets, experiments, knobs, filing
rows.body: foundation/clockwork.py measures freshness of every pipeline stage against its own SLA, wakes a stale stage's workflow (bounded per day), settles every executor change under the name of its work item (an open change past the window is closed as expired and its item returns to the queue), and escalates by a stateless ladder: catch-up, mutate to the next item, p0 repair item. foundation/pm.py is the product manager loop: targets on a straight-line trajectory, experiments kept or replaced after a week, three bounded knobs reviewed and reverted when the metric is no better, growth items filed from an idea bank and repair items filed from stale stages. Parking now reads the shared evidence branch, since a run's checkout held only its own rows and a failing item was retried forever. New workflow product-manager.yml; tests pass.

rows.title: heal pass flagged the heartbeat missing because it ran without the Cloudflare token
rows.body: The first scheduled heal pass could not read the tick clock, so the heartbeat stage showed missing and a catch-up was planned for a clock that was fine. An unreadable clock is now reported as unmeasured and never escalated, and both workflows pass the Cloudflare token to the heal step; tests pass.

rows.title: Product manager pass is quiet when nothing changes; parallel CLOCKWORK work adopted
rows.body: A daily pull request for a pass that filed nothing was noise: the report file changed every run. The report is now computed from live measurements for the public record, and only experiment state, knob changes and filed items are committed, so a quiet pass opens no pull request. Product manager pull requests no longer carry the executor marker, so settlement does not count them. rows.title: Unlearn becomes an evidence encyclopedia of beliefs to unlearn
rows.body: Rowan found the coaching-only Unlearn too unstructured. The tenant is now a clickable, encyclopedic site of popular beliefs the evidence contradicts, modelled on Practical Solutions, with each entry in a guided debunking order and an hourly evidence loop (Crossref DOIs, Europe PMC new reviews, freshness, review queue). The coaching tool stays at /coach.

rows.title: Unlearn improves itself: grounded review labels, automatic re-grading, Lab discovery, wording trials
rows.body: Rowan asked to grow Unlearn and make it run and improve automatically. Decision: a model may only label or re-word, never add facts; every label or draft must quote a sentence present in the abstract it read, re-words may add no number or name, entries' cited sources are never changed by a model, drafts live on /lab and are never published as entries, and wording trials need 40 answers per arm and a two-proportion z of 1.96 to replace the original.

rows.title: Unlearn tells famous-finding-retold stories by itself and gives readers a reason to come back daily
rows.body: Rowan wants far more narrative-vs-later-evidence entries, automated, and a sticky site that runs a year unattended. Decision: a retold topic with then/now timelines graded honestly; a second daily discovery search for replications and re-analyses; drafts reach their own page only after reader votes and only with an index citation, always labelled a draft from one paper; a myth of the day cycle, an Atom feed and a browser-only streak bring readers back without accounts or cookies.

rows.title: DEPTH-1 front-door ideas
rows.body: Front-door ideas must name a corpus, a method and a reason to return (Unlearn / Practical Solutions depth); one-trick ideas such as a single air-quality feed are refused by scripts/build_idea_bank.py.

rows.title: WORLDWIDE-1 and GROW-1 idea bank
rows.body: Front-door ideas list worldwide open data sources probed weekly (dead sources retire the idea); a weekly scout step asks the model route for one new idea admitted through every gate and rotates the oldest out beyond max_active.

rows.title: DEPTH-1 depth bar for self-chosen apps
rows.body: Rowan 2026-11-22: self-chosen apps must carry thesis, growing corpus, loop, hook, reason to return, public good and a 3-phase horizon; lookups, boards, templates and commerce never launch. Retired 8 shallow spinoffs; seeded base-rates, did-it-work, open-questions for the seed pipeline.

rows.title: STICKY-1: every system is judged on freshness, breadth, depth and diversity of content and promotes it
rows.body: Core module workers/core/stickiness (vendored in the seed) and tick step stickiness measure each system's JSON Feed, record a daily series, file STICKY-<id> while stale/thin/narrow, and serve unpromoted entries as a social queue. Admission is a stickiness block in instances/ultrastable/progress.json. Unlearn is a shrink-only baseline with no feed of its own; the ultrastable.io feed is the changelog, last updated 2026-11-17, so the loop will file STICKY-ultrastable.

rows.title: STICKY-1: audience is measured as visitor-days and daily feed readers
rows.body: The analytics beacon keeps nothing in the browser and visitor ids rotate daily (guard in seed/worker/test/analytics.test.js), so the step counts visitor-days from hits and daily feed readers (hits name feed, recorded server-side by the site worker). return_rate is computed only from a real returning count a system serves at audience_url, otherwise it reads unmeasured. Verified by seed/worker/test/stickiness.test.js.

rows.title: CHANGE-1 behaviour-change library required by the depth bar
rows.body: Rowan 2026-11-22: humans are the weak link from evidence to action. Every deep idea names at least 3 evidence-based moves from doctrine/change-methods.json covering notice, update and act; ideas.depth() enforces it and the idea bank inherits it.

rows.title: One depth rule for ideas and apps
rows.body: build_idea_bank.py calls foundation/ideas.py depth() so front-door ideas and self-chosen apps share DEPTH-1 (thesis, corpus, loop, returns, hook, public_good, horizon).

rows.title: Owner console shows only what is true; the system closes its own fix tasks
rows.body: Session: session_0156nqDuBwwRB8fWQWzUbU4L. Rowan 2026-11-22: /owner and the digest were noise. OWNER-LINKS-3, SELF-FIX-2, LEGACY-TASKS-1, DIGEST-QUIET-1, PLAN-FACT-1, SELFCHECK-FRESH-1 in dashboard/worker.js and seed/analytics/analytics.js; fleet tasks read-only, no owner buttons.

rows.title: POST-FEEDBACK-1: engagement read back and scored per arm
rows.body: Public like, repost and reply counts for Bluesky and Mastodon posts are read a day after posting, stored on social_posted and used to break ties between equally ranked posts. The relay's AI-generated marker (qnfo-social, Quniverse account, Art. 50) is left as is: its source is not in these repos and a redeploy without it risks losing bindings.

rows.title: Promotion is part of every tenant's role; Unlearn promotes itself
rows.body: TENANT-PROMO-1 (Rowan 2026-11-22). Unlearn serves /social-queue.json (one belief every 2 days from 2026-11-23, built by the shared seed/worker/src/promoqueue.js), listed in social/gate.json tenant_queues and drained by the core publisher, which now takes tenants in turn (fairOrder). Unlearn is a live showcase on ultrastable.io and every Unlearn page links its live siblings from doctrine/stakeholders.json. foundation/tenantpromo.py --check (in checks) fails any system in progress.json that does not promote itself. Practical Solutions linking Unlearn from its own pages is a change in ultrastable/practical-solutions; it is cross-promoted from ultrastable.io and from Unlearn meanwhile.

rows.title: STICKY-1: the stickiness step files its item with a small reserve above the daily item limit
rows.body: The stickiness step now passes cap = ORIGINATE_MAX_PER_DAY + STICKY_RESERVE (5) to ensureItem. Item ids are fixed per system, so a refile is a no-op. Evidence: live D1 had stickiness_state rows but no STICKY items while budget_ledger showed 20 of 20 used. Verified by seed/worker/test/stickiness.test.js.

rows.title: Every tenant app lives in its own repository; Unlearn moves to ultrastable/unlearn
rows.body: Rowan: a tenant app needs its own repo. Decision: a registry (doctrine/tenant-repos.json), a workflow that creates the repo from the tenant folder's history with vendored core files, and a core deploy route that builds a topology worker from its tenant repository's main (source.repo), redeployed daily when that main moves. A check fails new tenant code in the core. Deploys go through the core's OIDC deployer, so the tenant repository holds no credential and the deploy gateway's rules stay as they are.

rows.title: Unlearn change layer: graded practices with private trials
rows.body: Rowan asked for evidence-based change, not only debunking. Practices are full graded entries with a trial kit; all personal trial data stays in the reader's browser; the server counts anonymous events per practice and re-orders suggested if-then plans by keep rate; oversold claims (power posing, ego depletion, growth mindset) get no kit; the Lab drafts candidate practices from intervention reviews under the same grounding guards.

rows.title: CHANGELOG-FRESH-1 ingest new commits
rows.body: The public changelog only grew when a row was recorded by hand; commits now become public change rows on every product-manager pass (provenance --ingest-new). Never run --changelog --apply from a session: the local ledger is thin and it shrinks the file.

rows.title: Tenant repo creation needs a credential the workflow actually holds
rows.body: TENANT-REPO-1: tenant-repos.yml had only ORG_ADMIN_TOKEN and LANE_PAT (both unbound), so ultrastable/unlearn was never created; it also word-split jq rows with a for-loop. Third route added: the lane GitHub App minting an installation-wide token with administration and contents write (lane_credential.py org-token); rows are read with while-read.

rows.title: MOBILE-LAYOUT-1: phone header budget lives in core/ui
rows.body: core/ui siteHeader keeps items flagged primary in the bar and puts the rest under a script-free More disclosure; familyBar shows its text before the colon on phones. Tenants enforce a 390px budget (chrome <=170px, h1 inside first screen, no sideways scroll, 44px header targets) with a browser check in CI.

rows.title: SEED-AUTONOMY-1: a seed that answers /health is not autonomous
rows.body: Probed 2026-11-23: GET https://ultrastable-seed-second-tenant.ultrastable.workers.dev/health returned 200 with tick 207 complete while the same report read stalled at ignition stage ticking with 13 loops failing. Root cause: deploy/deploy-seed.mjs binds only DB and PUBLIC_HEALTH_ONLY, so a generated seed has no source-control credential and no repository of its own, and the launch gate judged /health alone. This change: /health carries the ignition stage, seedadmit --autonomy with detector seed-autonomous fails a seed below looping 48 h after its first live row, the year gate refuses undrilled faults, and health fetches name their client (the default Python user agent got 403 at the edge, so detector seed-live was failing on a seed that answered). Tests pass: tests.foundation.test_seedadmit, seed/tests/test_seed.py, seed/worker/test/health-ignition.test.js. The credential root cause is OL-20261123-1.

rows.title: Growth loop and code agents starved the queue after 11-22
rows.body: GROWTH-STARVE-1 + MODELS-ORG-1 (2026-11-25, Session: session_0156nqDvJ5oNPSCVZzS8cYKL): queue drained to 0; PM skipped unmeasured metrics; GitHub Models answered 200 OK text. Unmeasured metrics now count as behind under the growth target; github-models retries the org endpoint.

rows.title: parked/ PRs had no SLA clock (PARKED-PR-1)
rows.body: The branch reaper parks sessions as parked/<name> and completion_sweep opened automerge PRs for them; neither sweeper CLIENT_PREFIX nor sla BOT_PREFIX covered parked/, so 17 PRs aged past 8 h and agewatch failed the fleet job every pass. Both prefixes now include parked/, and the sweep skips parked/ and already-closed tips.

rows.title: seedlife probe test read the wall clock (time bomb)
rows.body: test_stages_advance_only_with_evidence called seedlife.probe with the real clock against a verify written at a fixed 2026-11-21 NOW; once 48 h passed the test failed on every PR (red tests-a, unrelated to the diff). probe now takes now= and the test passes the fixture clock.

rows.title: IMPACT-LOOP-1: generic impact and reach loop in core/impact
rows.body: core/impact records metric series, detects plateaus, plans bounded lever items with predictions and settles them; tenants declare metrics and levers. Practical Solutions is the first consumer.

rows.title: Growth metrics read through the site Worker, not a token in Actions
rows.body: GROWTH-HITS-1 (2026-11-25, Session: session_0156nqDvJ5oNPSCVZzS8cYKL): the Cloudflare token never reached Actions, so growth metrics were empty for days. The site Worker already binds the analytics D1, so it serves the four 7-day aggregates at /api/growth/hits and foundation/growth.py falls back to it when no token is present. No credential crosses into Actions.

rows.title: The live page showed 0 merged PRs
rows.body: LIVE-COUNT-1 (2026-11-25, Session: session_0156nqDvJ5oNPSCVZzS8cYKL): /live How much code ships read 0 in every row. The snapshot builds it from one gh pr list GraphQL call; when that call fails or times out, _sh returns empty and 0 is published as fact. A REST fallback now fills the count, and transparency --probe-merged fails the workflow when /live shows 0 while GitHub has merges in the last 7 days.

rows.title: retriage and org-profile probe ran weekly; their issues sat open for days (SLA-ISSUE-1)
rows.body: scripts/retriage.sh was documented as every 3 h but its cron is weekly (budget), so the rolling Retriage gaps issue (#2032) never refreshed; org-profile-probe is weekly, never closes its own issue and grepped for 'runs itself', a phrase absent from the profile README (#2033). Both now run from the 10-minute fleet clock; scripts/org_profile_probe.sh closes its issue on pass and checks the README headline.

rows.title: BRANCH-CLEANUP-1
rows.body: No branch outlives its PR. branchsweep --remote runs scripts/branch_cleanup.py daily: enforces delete_branch_on_merge and deletes merged or closed PR branches in every fleet repo.

rows.title: Unlearn now lives in ultrastable/unlearn
rows.body: Rowan created the empty repo on 2026-11-25. A code session split instances/unlearn with its history, vendored promoqueue.js, stakeholders.json and models.json, and pushed it. The core keeps only the manifest; topology and system.json name source repo ultrastable/unlearn; seedlife reads build paths from build.repo; the system renderer writes a repo-root wrangler config for tenant workers. The tenant-repos workflow still has no org credential, so future tenant moves need the repo created first.

rows.title: A tenant move touches more than the folder
rows.body: Moving Unlearn out broke the decision ledger, the topology main check, system.json, seedlife build paths and a core test that read the tenant's phases. Tenant checks now live in the tenant repo next to the code; core checks read source repos from topology.

rows.title: gh issue search read a title prefix as a qualifier
rows.body: org_profile_probe.sh found its issue with --search 'org-profile-probe: ... in:title'; the leading org-profile-probe: is parsed as a search qualifier, so a passing probe never closed issue 2107 and failing runs could file duplicates. It now matches the exact title over the open list.

rows.title: branchsweep modify/delete conflict
rows.body: branchsweep failed daily on a modify/delete conflict (checkout --ours had no ours stage), so its remote cleanup step never ran. Main's deletion now wins.

rows.title: branch cleanup runs in the lane
rows.body: scripts/branch_cleanup.py runs from the lane's completion sweep on every scheduled lane pass, as a second route beside branchsweep --remote.

rows.title: What Works tenant: grades computed, deploy after owner go-ahead
rows.body: New tenant what-works (policy evidence atlas). Grades come only from worker/grade.js over curated and read-in trials; a model may only label design and direction with verbatim abstract quotes. Code registered to move to ultrastable/what-works. Worker, D1 and route are added to doctrine/topology.json once the owner confirms the production deploy.

rows.title: branch cleanup keeps evidence branches
rows.body: Ledger branches named *-evidence are kept by branch_cleanup.py, and each repo is handled on its own so one 404 does not end the pass.

rows.title: Deploy What Works: Worker, D1 and route in the topology
rows.body: Rowan approved the deploy (2026-11-25). D1 ultrastable-what-works (c915e72c) created in the ultrastable account; Worker ultrastable-what-works builds from instances/what-works/worker while the tenant is moving to ultrastable/what-works; cron 17 * * * *; route what-works.ultrastable.org; clock what-works-beat with a /pulse/watch restart route; loop what-works-beat owned by the Worker.

rows.title: FRONTEND-AUTO-1: front-end and back-end lanes in the improve loop, engine in the seed
rows.body: seed/scripts/improve.py is the engine every system carries; each pass files one front-end and one back-end item; front-end items carry the UI/UX audit, Core Web Vitals and human-voice gate; lower-is-better metrics settle correctly.

rows.title: IMPROVE-1: impact and reach loop always has work
rows.body: foundation/improve.py runs daily in product-manager.yml: reach, impact and protected plus items every pass, missing signals are defects, market pass when R&D is stale, p0 stall per manager tier, closed items settled on their metric after 7 days.

rows.title: Replication Ledger seeded as a moving tenant (TENANT-REPO-1)
rows.body: Rowan 2026-11-25 asked for an encyclopedic replication ledger across fields, and restated that every Ultrastable deployment has its own GitHub repo and runs sandboxed as a tenant app. instances/replication-ledger holds the manifest plus a first-slice worker (data model, computed standing rubric, Crossref-backed add/verify CLI, 25 findings in 5 fields, 6 replication projects); doctrine/tenant-repos.json registers it as moving so tenant-repos.yml creates ultrastable/replication-ledger from the folder's history. Seed DOIs are unchecked until Q-RLEDGER-VERIFY: this session had no route to Crossref.

rows.title: What Works moved to its own repository
rows.body: Rowan created ultrastable/what-works (2026-11-25) and asked for it to be public. The tenant folder was split with its history, the core files it reads vendored (tenantrepos --prepare) and a CI workflow added; topology now builds ultrastable-what-works from that repository's main (worker/index.js), the registry state is moved and the worker code left the core. Seedlife and deploy read the repository over raw.githubusercontent.com, so it must be public.

rows.title: AUTO-MERGE-DEFAULT-1
rows.body: branch_cleanup.py sets allow_auto_merge and delete_branch_on_merge on every fleet repo and every tenant repo listed in doctrine/tenant-repos.json, from the lane's completion sweep.

rows.title: Unlearn is judged on its own feeds
rows.body: progress.json's Unlearn row read ultrastable.io's feed and healed with ci.yml, which ships nothing. It now reads unlearn.ultrastable.org/feed.xml, heals with vendor-sync.yml then ci.yml, and declares a stickiness block on the new JSON Feed (ultrastable/unlearn#2).

rows.title: One tenant's missing credential stopped every tenant's redeploy
rows.body: tenant-repos.yml exited on the first tenant it could not create (replication-ledger, no ORG_ADMIN_TOKEN/LANE_PAT/lane App in this repo) and the redeploy step had no if, so moved tenants such as Unlearn were never redeployed by it. Now each tenant failure is recorded and skipped, the run still fails at the end, and the redeploy step runs unless cancelled.

rows.title: FULLSTACK-1: every system deploys repo, back end and a public web UI
rows.body: Rowan 2026-11-25 asked that every Ultrastable system deploy its repo, back end and public web UI by itself. tenantrepos --check now fails a registered tenant with no public front end (a live topology Worker with a route, or an https frontend); deploy-ultrastable redeploys tenant code still moving in instances/*/worker. The Replication Ledger gains reader pages in worker/site.js and the topology Worker ultrastable-replication-ledger with route replication-ledger.ultrastable.org; seedlife verifies its /health after the deploy.

rows.title: Replication Ledger keeps itself current: the hourly discovery beat is the core
rows.body: Rowan, 2026-11-25: static content is not autonomous and is contrary to the objective of an Ultrastable system. The hand-written findings are now only the ledger's seed. instances/replication-ledger/worker/discover.js and store.js run an hourly beat (cron 23 * * * *, plus a spark from any request when the last beat is over two hours old). It searches OpenAlex for works citing each original that report a replication, files a kind and outcome only under a verbatim-quote guard (Workers AI, then a fixed lexical reader), keeps everything else as leads, finds landmark originals not yet held from recent replication papers' references, flags retractions and checks seed citations at Crossref. Each standing move is a standing_changes row served at /changes and /feed.json; /api/freshness answers 503 when a finding goes unchecked for thirty days. State is kept in D1 ultrastable-replication-ledger, whose schema the Worker creates itself. Probe: node --test instances/replication-ledger/worker/discover.test.mjs. Residual risk: the OpenAlex query syntax was exercised only against a fake in tests, because this session's egress refuses api.openalex.org; /api/beats records each beat's errors so the first live beat shows any mismatch.

rows.title: STATIC-CONTENT-1: a page that never changes is a failure mode
rows.body: Rowan 2026-11-25: static content is not autonomous. foundation/staticcontent.py hashes each system's sitemap pages daily into ops/static-content.json and the static-content detector fails when a page is unchanged for max_unchanged_days; a young ledger is unmeasured, never a pass.

rows.title: org profile probe: grep -q in a pipe under pipefail reads a pass as a failure
rows.body: echo page | grep -q dies of SIGPIPE under pipefail on a large page; use a here-string.

rows.title: Tenant liveness hid a dead loop (What Works launch)
rows.body: On What Works' launch /health said ok while every OpenAlex call answered 429 and every Europe PMC call 503, so no programme was ever checked; overlapping catch-up beats from visits caused the burst and duplicate first grades. Liveness must report each part of the loop with its own ok, and the platform reads every tenant's parts live (tenantrepos --health, detector tenant-health). A tenant merge now ships within the hour via the tick's tenant-deploy step.

rows.title: What Works went live; repo creation and visibility still needed the owner
rows.body: What Works is live at what-works.ultrastable.org (deploy 2026-11-25 15:42 UTC, custom domain attached although deploy-ultrastable reports ultrastable.org routes unreadable). Two steps needed Rowan: creating ultrastable/what-works and making it public, because tenant-repos.yml has none of its three credential routes bound (same gap as tenant-repo-unlearn). Tenant repos must be public: seedlife and deploy read them over raw.githubusercontent.com. This change adds What Works to progress, stickiness, the showcase and the social queue (TENANT-PROMO-1).

rows.title: Workers calling OpenAlex need the polite pool; closed seed items need evidence
rows.body: The Replication Ledger's first live beat (beat 1, 2026-11-25 16:21 UTC, /api/beats) got HTTP 429 from OpenAlex on every call: Workers share outbound addresses and anonymous calls are limited by address. discover.js oa() now sends the project's published contact (security.txt address) as mailto, which OpenAlex serves from its polite pool, and retries a 429 once. Second lesson: seedlife --run closed Q-SEED-what-works with no Evidence line, which turned closedloop --check red on main; it now writes the probe it passed as Evidence. Probe: node --test instances/replication-ledger/worker/ and tests/foundation/test_seedlife.py. Residual risk: whether the polite pool clears the 429 is known only after the next live beat.

rows.title: BREADTH-1: owner edits to suggestions steer the idea bank
rows.body: The owner's edit to a front-door suggestion is stored in owner_edits in doctrine/idea-bank.json and shown to the grow prompt; build_idea_bank.py validate() now turns away ideas that hold a narrow phrase. Verified by tests/test_idea_bank.py.

rows.title: DATAGRAPH-1: every system keeps a knowledge graph of all its data
rows.body: Owner directive 2026-11-25. Built as core/datagraph (deterministic extraction from the data: rows are nodes, key-equal values and ids in text are edges), the seed tick step knowledge-graph (bi-temporal D1 storage, hash-diff writes, PageRank, communities, bridges, orphans, Adamic-Adar leads settled against later data, calibrated kind weights, KG-ORPHANS items), a privacy-gated read side (/api/graph*, /graph), and doctrine/knowledge-graph.json with foundation/datagraph.py --check covering every system. LLM extraction and Leiden are upgrade paths, not the default: schema-first extraction and topology heuristics are cheaper and competitive. Research: docs/research/knowledge-graph.md.

rows.title: DISCOVER-1: public by default, every system discoverable
rows.body: Every live tenant is listed and cross-linked on ultrastable.io from the registries; seeded systems self-register daily via their public manifest; external listings are verified, rechecked daily and dropped on opt-out, noindex or 3 failures. Only ultrastable/ops stays private.

rows.title: FULLSTACK-1: repository, back end and public front end for every system
rows.body: Every system is checked for all three parts by foundation/fullstack.py: check runs in checks, live runs daily in tenant-repos.yml. Verified by tests/foundation/test_fullstack.py. The second-tenant seed has a back end only and carries Q-FULLSTACK-second-tenant.

rows.title: Knowledge graphs: the platform runs DATAGRAPH-1, tenants with domain data run the shared engine
rows.body: The platform keeps DATAGRAPH-1 (seed step knowledge-graph, zero-config over every table). Tenants with domain data run seed/worker/src/knowledge.js with their own mappers (built rows in doctrine/knowledge-graph.json, vendored through doctrine/tenant-repos.json). The two engines share kg_* table names with different schemas, so never both on one D1.

rows.title: LAUNCH-PATH-1: a visitor with no code agent launches from one form post
rows.body: An idea typed at ultrastable.io gets a launch record (site/graduate.js). deploy/launch-apps.mjs, run daily by tenant-repos.yml, deploys the idea's own system through the site worker's OIDC route, creates its repository from ultrastable/seed, files the owner's plain-words requests there and invites the owner on request. Without an org credential the app stays live and managed and the repository waits (gate visitor-app-repos). A test idea walks the front door on every run. Still open: Q-LAUNCH-1, Q-LAUNCH-2.

rows.title: SYNC-BOTH-WAYS-1: tenants pull the platform and lift general code up
rows.body: tenantsync now opens its pull requests over REST with the token passed in, clones ultrastable/practical-solutions, measures days behind per tenant and lifts reaching the core, and files Q-SYNC items with their own probes. Seeded systems also pull the kernel weekly with their own token.

rows.title: Workers AI for the executor goes through the site Worker's OIDC route (AI-OIDC-1)
rows.body: The repo's Cloudflare secrets name the retired account and cfaccount strips them, so every workers-ai rung was unavailable. With id-token: write, a workers-ai rung with no Cloudflare secret calls /__internal/cf with ai/run/@cf/<model>, an allow-listed path in site/deployer.js.

rows.title: A graph of all data is a disclosure surface
rows.body: Joining every table links records that were separate, and the platform D1 holds people's replies and owner answers. Personal and secret tables are excluded at extraction, and the public read view shows only counts, orphan findings and kinds a system declares public; the owner bearer sees the rest.

rows.title: A second route written in one entry point is dead if the loop calls another
rows.body: MODELS-ORG-1 added the GitHub Models org-endpoint fallback in agents.invoke, but the executor calls agent_ladder.transport, which built and sent the request itself, so the fallback never ran and every executor run failed on 200 text/plain OK. Both now go through agents.request.

rows.title: A test must not read the live queue it is testing
rows.body: Session: session_0156nqDu4uGc3HMjQ8qCqHyK. test_pm GrowthStarve read main's docs/issues, so it failed whenever the product manager had already filed growth items, which is every product-manager PR. Patch queue reads in tests.

rows.title: A visitor app needs a repo token scoped to its one repository
rows.body: The app's own Worker asks its host (the tick Worker) for a one-hour installation token limited to its repository, proved by an HMAC key the deployer binds. No app holds an org-wide credential.

rows.title: DISCOVER-1 probe caught two new tenants
rows.body: discover --check failed twice when a tenant went live without a showcase (What Works, Replication Ledger). Both were added. Next: file the showcase automatically from the tenant's IDEA.md. Session: session_0156nqDvKe54xZ9t3tXhvDPH. The red suites on this branch were fixed by Session: session_0156nqDu4uGc3HMjQ8qCqHyK (commit a176393f).

rows.title: Generated trajectory data must be regenerated on merge and landed by the watchdog
rows.body: test_trajectory went red on main because the watchdog wrote ops/trajectory.* but never landed site/trajectory-data.js, and regen-generated did not run the trajectory generator.

rows.title: MERGE-NOW reconcile looped on a code conflict, pushing empty commits
rows.body: On a PR with a hand-written conflict, mergenow.reconcile set generated files to main's copy even when they already matched, committed the unchanged tree, failed the merge with 409, and the synchronize event from its own commit ran it again: 34 empty commits in four minutes on #2165, each starting CI. It now commits only when the new tree differs from the head tree.

rows.title: Silent loops and frozen pages: a green run is not a landed result
rows.body: Session: session_0156nqDu4uGc3HMjQ8qCqHyK. 2026-11-25 audit: seed kit-sync failed every scheduled run for 3 days unseen; /balance froze because only balance --gate ran; /changelog froze because it rode the product-manager PR, which went red and was superseded. foundation/selftest.py now checks every scheduled workflow in the org and every generated site data stamp, as failure-audit detectors.

rows.title: spinoffs deployed with retired-account secrets for 4 days (SPINOFF-DEPLOY-2)
rows.body: spinoff.yml ran wrangler with CLOUDFLARE_* repo secrets (retired account) and a D1 id that only exists there; it failed daily from 2026-11-21 and the live worker kept serving retired apps. ultrastable-spinoffs is now in doctrine/topology.json, deploys through deploy-oidc.mjs, and deploy-ultrastable watches spinoffs/**. The uiux live audit reads retirement from spinoffs/registry.json.

rows.title: The credential everyone said was missing was already in the tick Worker
rows.body: Three gates said no credential could create an org repository. The tick Worker's sealed store held a live administration App token the whole time; the gate listed that route as not tried. Read the credential store before recording a credential gate (PATHFINDER-1). APP-REPO-1 uses it.

rows.title: The seed asked a hosted owner for cloud and model keys
rows.body: Walking the policy atlas idea through the seed's bootstrap opened cards asking the owner to set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and to approve spending. A person with no code agent cannot do that. IDEA.md now takes hosted_by; the host deploys and binds models and the bootstrap opens no secret or budget card (HOSTED-1).

rows.title: Graph skips underscore bookkeeping tables

rows.title: A health route that answers is not a healthy system: the Practical Solutions backend was 23 migrations behind
rows.body: Reading the fleet contract live after the deploy showed Practical Solutions /health 503. Root cause: the deploy's D1 migration step stopped at an old numbering (the vendor renumbered its files), so the live database lacked 23 additive migrations and the backend tick failed 12 of 41 steps on missing tables; the old /health had reported ok. Fix: the tenant's self-apply list carries them, the shared applier applies each migration as one batched call and at most four per run, and a tenant test fails any migration that is on neither the deploy ledger nor the self-apply list. Also from the same live reading: write routes a page posts to answer a read with 405 (the site answered 404), and a community health file served from the org's .github repository satisfies the repository standard.

rows.title: The published template must pass its own suites standalone: two kit tests read platform files, and two kit workflows skipped the filing gate
rows.body: After the first template publish the seed repository failed its own tests. Causes in the core's kit: two Worker tests read deploy/ and site/ without being on the monorepo-only register, and improve.yml and redteam.yml committed docs/issues without the balance gate the kit's own balance check requires. The publish also holds back files that differ in the copy, so a half-updated template is possible; that drift is tracked as Q-FLEETMAP-seed. Fix: the platform-only assertions are their own registered tests, both workflows pass the gate, and a kit test fails any test that reads above the kit unregistered.

rows.title: Copies drift silently unless one source generates them and a check compares
rows.body: On 2026-11-25 the seed template was 132 files behind seed/ (kit-sync never copies workflows), satellite agent files told agents a human must review protected changes, two tenant repos had no settings entry, a hosted boot still asked for three tokens, six seed workflows ignored HALT. Fix: seed/doctrine/system.json as the one definition, coherence --check in checks, a daily clean room. Limit: a sandbox reaches 'ticking' only; critical needs real deploys and is read from live systems.

rows.title: Q-FLEETMAP-seed: seed/ is the one source for the template again
rows.body: ultrastable/seed held 12 files seed/ lacked and 3 files it had regenerated from its own state (README.md, SYSTEM.md, docs/claims.json), so every publish held files back. Carried up into seed/: the daily balance workflow and its test, the VERIFY-1 model checker (scripts/verify.py, scripts/verify_spend.mjs, doctrine/verification.json, its test) and the human-voice lint with its config. Not carried, because seed/ already holds them under another name: doctrine/balance.json (autonomy/balance.json), doctrine/system.json (autonomy/system.json), worker/src/stepplan.js and its test (tick.js and tick.test.js). Those four are template_contents.retired in doctrine/fleet-map.json and a publish removes them; SYSTEM.md is template_contents.generated, so the generator's output replaces the template's copy. NOTICE, COMMERCIAL-TERMS.md, SECURITY.md and kit-sync.yml stay template-only in keep. fleetmap --check proves each retired or generated entry is one exact path with a reason and a seed/ file behind it. Lesson: a copy that keeps a duplicate of a renamed file regenerates different output from the same generator, so a never-delete publisher needs a declared way to retire a path.

rows.title: ROLE-ALIGN-1: every automated role names its human counterpart, its decisions and its clock
rows.body: Owner asked (2026-11-26) what the roles are and how they align with human software development roles. doctrine/managers.json now carries human_role, decides, inputs, hands_to and cadence per role and a software_roles coverage map of 22 software-organization functions; managers --check enforces them and managers --roles prints them. No role was created outside the TEAM-1 phase gate: security, finance, data and developer relations are done today by code that existing roles own, and their dedicated roles stay in doctrine/team.json phase 2. Sales and partnerships is the one gap (Q-ROLE-sales-partnerships); no loop reads open secret-scanning and Dependabot alerts (Q-ROLE-security). The 12 scheduled manager workflows are declared clocks in doctrine/clocks.json; their beats are the workflow runs GitHub records, and the watchdog restarts them under their declared ids.

rows.title: REPO-SHAPE-1: split by rate of change and owner; state leaves git
rows.body: Evidence: python3 -m foundation reposhape --report on main reads 4,548 tracked files, 482 in the kernel (seed/) and 1,489 in state (queue items, ledgers, packets), a state share of 0.3274 against a budget of 0.25. Decision: every path has a class in doctrine/repo-shape.json; state moves to D1 items, the evidence branches and R2 under Q-SHAPE-state-out-of-git (one area per PR, archived before it leaves main, closing probe reposhape --probe state); the size of a change is gated once, by SMALL-CHANGE-1 (seed/scripts/prsize.py), and an oversize branch is carried by reposhape --split as a stack of in-budget branches sized from the same config, with the original kept. No work is deleted, and the full specification move stays with the DISCLOSE-1 session.
